supersedes.note: The exclusion was correct when it was made: the Council's published term forbids transfer for compensation without its express permission, and no permission had been given. It is left exactly as written. A successor records that the answer changed; it does not pretend the old answer was wrong.

alsoSupersedes.why: That record held a reported grant whose scope could not be read from the report. The scope is now stated. It is retired to historical coordination evidence and no longer participates in authorization.

historicalDecisionPreserved.notRewritten: Permission had not been represented as obtained when that worker completed its assignment. That was true then and the record stays as written.

provenance.underlyingEvidence: original hard-copy permission retained by project owner
provenance.documentNotRequested: The project owner determined that the attestation is controlling and that a scan is not required. The absence of a repository copy is recorded as a fact about the evidence, not as a defect in it.
provenance.whatIsAssertedHere: Only what the project owner attested: that permission was received and what it covers. No issuer, signer, title, document date, expiry or operative letter text is asserted, because this record has not read the document.
whatIsNotAsserted: the date the permission was signed
any verbatim language of the grant
any attribution condition beyond those recorded as boundaries below
provenance.ifTheHardCopyLaterEntersCustody: Bind it by hash and reconcile its terms against the authorized acts and boundaries recorded here. Where the document is narrower than this record, the document governs and this record is superseded in turn.

granted: provide completed or partially completed forms to participants
use the covered forms within LegalEase's paid record-clearing service
retain source copies internally for implementation and verification

boundaries.note: Not granted, and not inferable from anything above. Every one of these is a thing a court or an outside party does, or a thing that would misrepresent the form or its issuer.
notGranted: changing form titles, numbers or revision marks
applying this permission to forms issued by another publisher
boundaries.thirdPartyFieldRuleUnchanged: The adopted authority's rule stands: judge, clerk, prosecutor, law-enforcement, agency, notary and process-server fields remain blank unless the governing form expressly assigns the field to the participant. Permission to reproduce a form is not permission to complete somebody else's part of it.
boundaries.prefillIsParticipantFactsOnly: Deterministic case information means facts already fixed by the participant's own record — case number, county, court, charge, disposition date. It does not extend to a finding, an order, a hearing date the court has not set, or a fact about service that has not happened.

coveredDocumentsNote: The nine Kansas Judicial Council documents that constitute the current RCAP Kansas form family — the same nine the superseded exclusion named. The scope is stated as a list rather than as a family so that a document nobody has considered cannot be swept in by a category. Anything not on this list falls through to the open jurisdiction-level licence question and stays fail-closed.
doesNotExtendTo: local court forms not issued by the Kansas Judicial Council
forms issued by any other publisher
any successor revision of a covered form, until the currentness owner establishes the successor and the permission is confirmed to reach it

currentnessIsIndependent.statement: This record answers whether LegalEase may reproduce and prefill these forms. It does not answer whether these are still the Council's current forms, and it must never be read as answering it.
currentnessIsIndependent.why: Three of the nine were recorded from 2013 and 2016, and the Council's Legal Forms pages return HTTP 403 to automation. A packet built on a superseded revision is wrong however well authorized it is.
currentnessIsIndependent.consequenceForAssignability: permissionObtained and generationAllowed are true now. Implementation assignability stays blocked on the exact currentness question and on nothing else.

receiptTreatment.note: Authorization is a permission fact and materialization is an evidence fact. A verified retained form may become worker-authorized without a single byte changing, and no receipt is touched because the licence answer moved.

expectedDownstreamEffect: The nine covered Kansas identities move from licence-blocked to authorized. Currentness, identity, role, field-map and legal-design gates are untouched and continue to gate independently. No packet becomes ready, no counsel adoption is recorded, no route is promoted, no runtime is enabled.

residualBlockers.question: Are the nine recorded revisions still the Council's current revisions?
The hard copy is retained by the project owner and not bound by hash in the repository.
residualBlockers.why: Recorded so the evidence basis is legible to a later reader, not as a blocker. The project owner determined the attestation is controlling.
